Two weeks went by with no contact from the practice, and when we phoned we were told he tested positive for a UTI and had a prescription waiting. On a another note my elderly grandmother has on multiple occasions been left without vital pain relief for her chronic condition due to the GP not signing the prescription before putting it through to the pharmacy for delivery, causing her condition to worsen.

These are just a couple of the times they have received substandard and terrible care.

I have honestly never seen a worse doctors practice and I am astounded at the lack of care and clear medical negligence that occurs here regularly.
